mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_eval_run (eval_run_id, tenant_id, dataset_id, dataset_version, agent_id, agent_profile_version, model_id, harness_config_identity, status, total_samples, completed_samples, passed_samples, failed_samples, not_evaluated_samples, metrics_json, error_summary, created_by, row_version, started_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{evalRunId}, #{tenantId}, #{datasetId}, #{datasetVersion}, #{agentId}, #{agentProfileVersion}, #{modelId}, #{harnessConfigIdentity}, #{status}, #{totalSamples}, #{completedSamples}, #{passedSamples}, #{failedSamples}, #{notEvaluatedSamples}, #{metricsJson}, #{errorSummary}, #{createdBy}, #{rowVersion}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt})

INSERT INTO agent_eval_result (result_id, tenant_id, eval_run_id, sample_id, sample_key, agent_run_id, trace_id, observed_intent, observed_mode, observed_context_plan_json, outcome_status, reason_code, outcome_evaluation_json, observed_tools_json, approval_observed, invalid_loop_observed, duration_ms, token_usage, token_usage_estimated, error_summary, created_at) VALUES (#{resultId}, #{tenantId}, #{evalRunId}, #{sampleId}, #{sampleKey}, #{agentRunId}, #{traceId}, #{observedIntent}, #{observedMode}, #{observedContextPlanJson}, #{outcomeStatus}, #{reasonCode}, #{outcomeEvaluationJson}, #{observedToolsJson}, #{approvalObserved}, #{invalidLoopObserved}, #{durationMs}, #{tokenUsage}, #{tokenUsageEstimated}, #{errorSummary}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_eval_run SET tenant_id = #{tenantId}, dataset_id = #{datasetId}, dataset_version = #{datasetVersion}, agent_id = #{agentId}, agent_profile_version = #{agentProfileVersion}, model_id = #{modelId}, harness_config_identity = #{harnessConfigIdentity}, status = #{status}, total_samples = #{totalSamples}, completed_samples = #{completedSamples}, passed_samples = #{passedSamples}, failed_samples = #{failedSamples}, not_evaluated_samples = #{notEvaluatedSamples}, metrics_json = #{metricsJson}, error_summary = #{errorSummary}, created_by = #{createdBy}, row_version = row_version + 1, started_at = #{startedAt}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE eval_run_id = #{evalRunId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND row_version = #{rowVersion}
